# Just Acoustics

> Just Acoustics is a Singapore-based acoustic treatment company that supplies and installs acoustic panels for offices, restaurants, churches, schools, studios, gyms, cinemas, and homes. Services include site assessment, custom panel design, and full installation. Established 2022.

## Contact
- Website: https://www.justacoustics.co

- Email: info@justacoustics.co
- Service area: Singapore

## Key facts
- Acoustic treatment improves sound quality inside a room by absorbing and managing reflections. It does not by itself stop sound travelling through walls, floors, doors, or windows.
- Just Acoustics provides consultation, acoustic panel supply, custom design, and installation across Singapore.
- Product performance, fire requirements, final dimensions, and installation methods are confirmed for the individual product and site before production or installation.
